serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Hello.
???: Hi, my name is Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt. Have I just stepped into the humble abode of one might call Anon?
You: Y-Yes, you are correct. I mean- that’s right…
Did {f_botName} really choose this guy? He was supposed to be shady, but there are levels to it…
First of all, what’s up with his name? There’s no way that’s his real name, no mother would punish their child like that.
Second of all, he’s wearing the most flashy shoes in existence. There’s a combination of around 5 different colored leathers with a shiny golden tip. His suit is light navy with a pink pocket square. 
On top of it all he wears sunglasses even though it’s pretty dark out here…
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: What? Is there something on my face? Or maybe you were stunned by my aura?
You: Yeah, something like that…
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Well, whatever. Let me get straight to the point. From what I’ve read in the email you have no chance in court. 
You: Huh? Then what are we supposed to do?
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: There’s a few ways. It all depends on what you want. If you want to punish your landlord for pissing you off, you can always sue him for a bunch of stuff and wait until you or him bleed out of money. When the lawyer fees get too high, he will come begging you to stop.
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: It’s a sure fire method, but it required a lot of money. I’m relatively cheap when it comes to lawfare. I AI generate all the court documents and that’s the beauty of it. None of it needs to make any sense! 
You: Right… {{wi}}I would rather not spend too much money on it…
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: As you wish. There are other ways. 
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: We could trick your landlord into lowering your rent himself.
You: How?
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Let’s just say it’s not my first rodeo with that landlord of yours. Our score is now tied. If you wanna gamble, there’s a 50% chance that we can succeed.
You: I will think about it…
You: Is there any other option left?
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: You can always try weaponizing the state against him, but he would probably declare a fatwa on you for that. This man is not playing around when it comes to snitches.
You: Yeah, let’s not do that…
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: So! What’s the decision?
You: Let’s try tricking him!
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: As you wish. I have a few tactics up my sleeve. Sometimes when I’m struggling on the toilet I take out my notepad and think of ways to get the better of him.
You: Right…
You: What if we fail?
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: He will probably kick you out! Hahaha!
You: …
With a rent this high I could probably find a similar place with a better landlord, so let’s just go with it.
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Should I proceed?
You: Yes please!
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Here’s the plan kiddo. You will trick the landlord into thinking that your mom works at the IRS. My little birds tell me that he’s been looking for someone on the inside for a long time so he should easily take the bait.
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: I will wait behind the corner with an audio recorder. He will try getting on your good side by lowering your rent and when he says it, I will record him and the job will be done!
You: Are you sure it will work?
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: No idea.
